ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 27 Oct 2026
points: Your site shows 15,000 reviews and a 4.8 rating, yet 0 of 30 ads carry either number. Buyers comparing supplements look for proof before they click. Put 15,000 reviews on the creative and open two new ads with a customer quote.
Your site offers 10% off your first order, yet 0 of 26 ads mention it. A new buyer has no reason to act today. Put the first order discount in the first line of three new ads.

10 of 26 ads lean on claim words like clinically, cure and guaranteed results. Those words cost reach, and buyers tune out promises they cannot check. Swap each claim for what customers noticed, like shine or volume, and test three versions.

11 of 26 ads are creator posts run from your brand page, so the voice belongs to someone else. Whitelist them from each creator account, so the ad runs under their name, then cut three variations of the best one.
